checks.command: pnpm --dir services/dsh test && pnpm --dir apps/app-field/runtime run typecheck
checks.proves: Catalog/backend and field runtime checks remain valid after field catalog closure changes.
checks.doesNotProve: Does not prove camera scanning or public readback on physical devices.
checks.passCriteria: Commands exit zero with targeted catalog/version/batch tests executed on the resulting SHA.
checks.failCriteria: Any catalog invariant, type, conflict, duplicate or targeted test failure fails.

checks.proves: Field catalog capture converges to exact required readers and native barcode behavior where required.
checks.doesNotProve: Does not cover general catalog admin, marketing or checkout.
checks.passCriteria: No local catalog truth, duplicate batch effect, stale overwrite or premature client visibility; all required readers converge.
checks.failCriteria: Any unresolved barcode requirement, false success, duplicate, stale reader or publication leak fails.
